summary: Reject positional authentication secrets without repeating their value.
reason: Tokens belong on stdin; Cobra argument errors otherwise echo credentials into logs. This downstream repair preserves the published authentication safety contract.
markers: return usageErr(fmt.Errorf("pass the token on stdin"))
reapply: Keep a custom Args validator on auth set-token that rejects positional arguments with a constant stdin instruction and usage exit 2. Never include argument values.
